name: Neero
desc:
Neero is a Celtor NPC. They are a Pathfinder wearing an Iron Mask along with the Pathfinder Cloak.

They are investigating the disappearance of the Forge of Sin and provides speculation about [Duke Erisia](entity:duke_ishamon_erisia)'s actions prior to the events of the [Lord Regent's](entity:the_lord_regent) questline, as well as lore about [Erisia](location:erisia) and the Forge itself.
additional_info:
-   Neero wears the old model of the Iron Mask, along with the Pathfinder Cloak.
-   Using shiftlock to see inside of his mask shows that Neero is a Celtor, based upon his facial markings.
